description: A filter in a CYCLOPS system, used to capture a filtering criterion

name.description: The short human-readable name of the filter

cond.description: An SQL-like WHERE condition. Deprecated in favour of jsonCond, which cannot be used to inject arbitrary commands.

jsonCond.description: A WHERE condition expressed as a structure rather than in CCMS's command language. The service validates it and generates the condition itself, so values are never interpreted as syntax.

template.description: Optionally, the name of another filter to duplicate

oneOf.description: The condition in CCMS's command language
